title: Vegetation and rainfall departures side by side (aligned_antecedent 1.1.1)
description:
Precomputed result of recipe aligned_antecedent 1.1.1: same-sign counts for windows of 0, 1, 2 and 3 months, reported together for both vegetation references. all years reference: 0 months 26 of 45; 1 months 25 of 45; 2 months 25 of 45; 3 months 29 of 44. leave one year out reference: 0 months 31 of 56; 1 months 32 of 56; 2 months 32 of 56; 3 months 36 of 56. Version 1.1.1 is post hoc: the leave-one-year-out reference and the zero rule were added after the first results (1.1.0), and the zero rule was applied to stored values after a second audit (1.1.1), all on 2026-10-27. Counting months that move together shows co-occurrence; it does not estimate how much of a change rainfall explains. Rainfall comes from 5 km grid cells, not from gauges in the valley. A short record can hold months that move together by chance. Values are compared as stored, V at four decimals and R_k at two; a month whose stored V or R_k is 0 has no sign and is left out of both counts. Counts are given for both vegetation references side by side; with the all-years reference a 7-year median often equals the month's own value, so more months have V exactly 0.

Revision 13 (2026-10-27). Among duplicates of a tile and date, an item with no clear pixels over the catchment is now skipped when a twin has some. That clause was added to the duplicate rule after data was first read; the rule fixed before any data was read kept the newest processing baseline only. Revision 12, the first committed, has no version field; it documented the clause but kept the newest item, so it kept an item with 0 clear pixels over the catchment on seven tile-dates: 29RQQ 2019-04-17 (twin had 285 clear pixels), 2019-06-21 (702,669), 2020-11-12 (84), 2021-06-07 (8), 2021-11-19 (8), 2021-12-22 (8), and 29SQR 2020-10-23 (16). In five cases the twin is an older baseline (02.14, 03.00, 03.01), so its clear pixels come from an older scene classification. This revision recomputes 2019-04, 2019-06, 2020-10, 2020-11, 2021-06, 2021-11 and 2021-12 and everything derived from them; no NDVI or departure area median moved at four decimals.

providers.processing:lineage: Deduplicated tile-date items (newest baseline), DN/10000 without offset, scene classification classes 4 and 5 kept, NDVI per observation, same-date tiles merged, per-pixel monthly median and date count, acceptance policy, area summaries over the frozen catchment (docs/reference/observation-preprocessing.md).

aligned_antecedent.title: V(t), P(t), R_k(t) and same-sign counts

siterra:dataset.access_route: Earth Search STAC API https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/, collection sentinel-2-l2a (legacy), COGs on sentinel-cogs.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com read by window

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Count of 10 m analysis pixels whose centres fall inside the frozen polygon, EPSG:32629

parameters.zero_rule: a stored value of 0 has no sign and is not counted: V at four decimals, R_k at two decimals

operation_order: V_ref(t) = monthly_departure area median for month t, for ref = all_years and ref = leave_one_year_out, each defined only where available
P(t) = catchment rainfall departure for month t from the 1991 to 2020 same-month mean, in mm
zero rule: values are compared as stored (V at four decimals, R_k at two); a month whose stored V_ref(t) or R_k(t) is 0 has no sign and is not counted
n_k(ref) = number of months with V_ref(t) and R_k(t) both defined and both non-zero
same_k(ref) = number of those months where V_ref(t) and R_k(t) have the same sign
all four windows and both references are reported together; none is selected
